stem: A Massachusetts collaborating pharmacist is negotiating an agreement that will include prescriptive practices. Which additional conditions attach because of that inclusion? Select all that apply.

choices.text: Holding at least $2,000,000 per occurrence of professional liability insurance.
Maintaining a current controlled substance registration issued by the Department during the term of the agreement.
Completing at least ten additional contact hours of continuing education each year of the agreement.
Submitting an attestation under the pains and penalties of perjury regarding MassHealth participation.
Obtaining a separate Board licence category for collaborating pharmacists.

explanation.core_reasoning: 247 CMR 16.02(1)(f) attaches three conditions where prescriptive practices are included: maintaining a current Department-issued controlled substance registration during the agreement term; completing the training required by M.G.L. c. 94C, § 18(e) before initially obtaining that registration and at least biennially thereafter as a condition precedent to renewing the pharmacist licence; and submitting a MassHealth participation attestation signed under the pains and penalties of perjury.

choice_analysis.A: The insurance requirement is at least $1,000,000 per occurrence and applies to all agreements.
choice_analysis.B: Correct: the controlled substance registration must be maintained during the term.
choice_analysis.C: The additional continuing education requirement is at least five contact hours each year.
choice_analysis.D: Correct: the sworn MassHealth attestation is one of the three conditions.
choice_analysis.E: No separate Board licence category is created for collaborating pharmacists.

related_facts: The section 18(e) training is a condition precedent to renewing the pharmacist licence, not only the agreement.
explanation.mpje_trap: General CDTM qualifications and the prescriptive-practice overlay are different lists with different numbers.

reasoning_steps: Separate the conditions that apply to all agreements from the prescriptive-practice overlay
Reject figures that belong to the general qualification list
